text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — Veridian (enterprise tenant) elevated 5xxs in eu2-dedicated. Paging oncall @rachael-sre. Incident runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/veridian-eu2
rachael-sre: I'm on it. Initial metric: 5xx spike started ~12:14 UTC, error rate ~7% for tenant-veridian in veridian-dedicated-eu2. Gathering logs and tagging eng-runtime.
eng-runtime-alex: oncall here. Looking at runtime logs — KV cache miss rate + OOM-ish evictions on nodes pool veridian-dedicated-eu2. Can someone confirm Dedicated vs VPC? @account-eng-jordan
account-eng-jordan: Veridian is on a dedicated, tenant-isolated pool (veridian-dedicated-eu2). Customer uses customer-managed DNS for api.veridian.com. CS and infra informed.
solutions-se-lee: Customer reports slow responses and token truncation on long-context requests (8k). Might be model fallback + cache pressure.
rachael-sre: I see pod evictions and replicas not scaling (autoscaler blocked). @infra-oncall-sam can you check quota/preemptible events in eu2?
infra-oncall-sam: Investigating — eu2 GPU availability low because of a partner batch job that consumed spare nodes. I can preempt that job to free 2 nodes; requesting additional quota as well.
deploy-bot: Event: autoscaler-blocker annotation created at 12:22 UTC for veridian-dedicated-eu2.
eng-runtime-alex: I'll preempt partner batch and recommend immediate traffic mitigation: start weighted traffic shift to warm fallback pool (veridian-eu1-warm) while we stabilize. dns cutover only if routing shift fails.
account-eng-jordan: Customer prefers minimal DNS changes. Can we do a 20% weighted shift to eu1 to reduce pressure and preserve sessions?
rachael-sre: That sounds good. Plan proposal: 1) route 20% to eu1 warm, 2) scale warm pool capacity to handle up to 50% if needed, 3) monitor errors for 15m and escalate to 50%/full cutover if >3% 5xx. Agree? @eng-runtime-alex
eng-runtime-alex: Agree. Also I'll pin model fallback rules to avoid quantized fallback where possible.
customer-infra-veridianops: We need session affinity preserved. Which endpoints get moved? All inference traffic to api.veridian.com?
solutions-se-lee: We'll proxy /v1/generate and /v1/chat through edge weighted routing. Sticky session headers preserved for proxied flows.
dns-oncall-maya: If DNS swap is needed later: recommended path — lower TTL to 60s, prepare CNAME veridian-edge -> veridian-eu1-alias, verify certs. I can lower TTL on request.
rachael-sre: Initiating weighted shift now. @eng-runtime-alex apply route policy veridian-weighted-eu2->eu1:20. Start 12:34 UTC.
eng-runtime-alex: Applied at 12:34:12 UTC. Edge routing shows ~20% to eu1. Observability: eu1 latency +~40ms, initial error rate downtrending.
rachael-sre: Scaling warm pool veridian-eu1-warm to +6 GPUs to prepare for more traffic. @infra-oncall-sam please confirm nodes join and KV warmup.
infra-oncall-sam: Scaling started 12:35. Preempted partner job freed 2 nodes. Request additional cloud quota approved; nodes joining: 3/6 @12:38, 6/6 @12:42.
eng-runtime-alex: New nodes joined, KV cache warmup in progress — transient latency spikes expected, overall errors dropping to ~2.1% across blended traffic.
customer-infra-veridianops: We see partial recovery, but some sessions reported token truncation ~12:39. ETA on resolution?
solutions-se-lee: Token truncation correlated with old fallback model. I pinned eu1 to quantized-v2->full-v2 preference and tightened fallback policy. Patch applied 12:40.
rachael-sre: Monitoring 5xx now ~1.8% across all traffic. Holding weighted shift. Next decision checkpoint at 12:55 UTC.
product-paul: FYI account — please update customer with short note: 'We initiated weighted shift to eu1 and scaled warm nodes; monitoring.'
account-eng-jordan: Notifying Veridian CSM and eng contact now. Message sent.
deploy-bot: Autoscaler event: scale_to=+6 GPUs complete @12:42 UTC.
eng-runtime-alex: At 12:53 eu2's 5xx for remaining 80% crept to ~3.6%. Recommend increase to 50% weighted shift now; if errors remain >3% after 10m do DNS CNAME swap. @rachael-sre approve?
rachael-sre: Approved. Execute 50% shift at 12:54.
eng-runtime-alex: Applied policy veridian-weighted-eu2->eu1:50 at 12:54:02 UTC. Observing error rate drop to ~1.2% within 3 minutes.
dns-oncall-maya: Preparing DNS plan if needed: lower TTL to 60s, pre-create CNAME veridian-edge->veridian-eu1-alias, confirm wildcard TLS covers eu1 host.
infra-oncall-sam: TLS certs valid for eu1 endpoint. Additional nodes spun in eu1 and ready for full capacity if we choose full cutover.
customer-infra-veridianops: We prefer to avoid DNS cutover unless necessary. Current metrics look good — keep us in the loop.
rachael-sre: Agreed. We'll maintain weighted routing and monitor. Next stable check 13:10 UTC. Post-incident actions: add quota preemption checklist for dedicated pools and improve autoscaler alerts for blocked replicas.
product-paul: Adding follow-ups: infra to add preemption runbook; eng-runtime to add autoscaler blocked-replica alert; account to review SLA credit process if customer requests. @jordan assign?
account-eng-jordan: Assigned. I'll coordinate with Veridian and capture notes for SLA review.
eng-runtime-alex: Closing active mitigation; keeping thread open for monitoring 2 hours.
deploy-bot: Incident annotation: mitigation=weighted-traffic-shift, nodes_scaled=+6, dns_changed=no, customer_impact=partial_degraded_but_mitigated.
rachael-sre: Marking incident mitigated at 13:07 UTC. Please add notes to runbook and schedule a follow-up postmortem if recurrence.
customer-infra-veridianops: Thanks all — appreciate the quick response. We'll monitor and escalate if we see regressions.
rachael-sre: Thanks team. Ending active paging. Will file incident notes and link to postmortem thread.
